error.fieldUnknown.purpose: Error when Use on a look-up names a detail it doesn't set (only title, artist, mix, remixer, label, year, album and catalogue number).

error.valueEmpty.purpose: Error when Use on a look-up is given a blank value; clearing a detail isn't done with Use.

error.notSendable.purpose: Error when a value given to Use has a character rekordbox can't take, or a year that isn't a number.
